title: AOT Routing
content:
Photon utilizes Ahead-of-Time compilation for route matching. This eliminates the need for expensive tree traversal at runtime. In version 1.2.0, we introduced Predictive Route Warming and Generation-based Cache Invalidation.

Predictive Route Warming

Call app.warmup(['/api/v1', '/auth']) during initialization to trigger the FTL (Faster Than Light) JIT compiler. This allows Photon to reach peak performance from the very first request, eliminating the "cold start" latency spikes common in Node.js/Bun runtimes.

Generation-based Cache

Middleware chains are now cached using a versioned generation system. Adding new static routes no longer invalidates the entire router's performance; instead, Photon uses O(1) version checking to lazily update only the necessary execution paths.

Dynamic Segments

app.get('/user/:id', (c) => {
  const id = c.req.param('id')
  return c.text('Authorized access: ' + id)
})
